citations.claim: first in_arena violation: body 0 centre past right boundary
one step before failure body already near right edge at high speed
body 0 gained ~30.6 m/s rightward velocity from collision just before

counterfactual.change: reduced body 1 initial vx from 27.7 to 10.0 so the body-body impact no longer launches body 0 at ~30 m/s; same 33 steps now passes with no violation

explanation: Stationary light body 0 is struck by fast heavy body 1 (vx~27.7) around steps 25-28, emerging with vx~30.64 m/s (step 28). Covering ~0.52 units per dt=0.017 step toward the right boundary, it goes from x~18.92 at step 32 to x~19.45 at step 33, overshooting the allowed centre (20-r-tol) by 0.25. The right boundary collision fails to stop/reflect it in time, so it exits the arena — fast-body boundary handling inadequate after energetic body-body momentum transfer.
vision_note: Across steps 30 to 32 the small red circle travels rightward toward the arena's right edge while the blue circle follows just to its left. In step 33 the red circle reaches the right boundary and visibly protrudes beyond it, half outside the arena.
